title: Per-repository Docker relationship data
description: One file per repository. Place it in the repos/ folder and index.html merges it into the graph. Images and containers are identified by Docker ID; if the same ID appears in multiple files, they are merged into a single node.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this structure. Increment it on an incompatible change.

name.description: Display name of the repository. Must be unique across files (key for the legend and color coding).

color.description: Optional. If omitted, index.html assigns one automatically from the default palette.

generatedAt.description: When this file was generated. Shown in the legend.

images.description: Images used by this repository. Includes the bases (ancestors) of derived images.

containers.description: Containers of this repository (including stopped ones).

id.description: Image ID (IMAGE ID from docker images --no-trunc). The node identifier.

tags.description: List of repository:tag names. An empty array for an unnamed image.

role.description: base = serves as the base of derived images, derived = built from another image, runtime = only started directly, not used as a base. If omitted, it is inferred from parent and whether children exist.

parent.description: ID of the image used as the base. Source of the "derive" edge.

id.description: Container ID (64 hex digits). The node identifier.

image.description: ID of the image the container was started from. Source of the "run" edge.
